en: This image shows two illustrated covers side-by-side. Both feature ornate frames and the year 1912. The left cover depicts a uniformed postal worker with medals, holding mail, and the right cover shows an elderly man with a mustache, wearing a decorated uniform, reading a document. Both images have German text and imperial symbols, including a coat of arms with a black eagle and a yellow shield, often associated with the Austro-Hungarian Empire.
